offering_description.value: Gogo sells in-flight internet, communications equipment and cabin systems to business aircraft owners and operators, aircraft manufacturers, and military and government aviation customers. It delivers connectivity through its North American air-to-ground network and through satellite networks that serve aircraft worldwide.

primary_products.value: Air-to-ground avionics; satellite terminals and antennas; cabin routers and Wi-Fi systems; flight operations software

primary_services.value: Air-to-ground broadband; satellite broadband; in-flight voice communications; managed connectivity

customer_segment.value: B2B: Business jet manufacturers, corporate flight departments, charter and fractional fleet operators, and aircraft management companies; B2C: Individual owners of private aircraft; B2G: Military and civilian government aviation operators

end_markets.value: Business aviation; private aviation; military and government aviation

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring plans for aircraft broadband and voice connectivity; product sales: Onboard avionics, antennas, satellite terminals and cabin networking equipment; transaction or usage fees: Data or airtime charges on usage-based plans
revenue_model.category: subscription; product sales; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Packages air-to-ground and satellite capacity into broadband and voice services for aircraft operators; OEM / manufacturer: Develops onboard connectivity equipment for aircraft manufacturers and aftermarket installers; asset operator: Runs a terrestrial radio network using licensed spectrum to connect aircraft over North America; software / platform: Uses aircraft and connectivity data to give flight departments tools for managing fleets and onboard networks
value_chain_position.category: service provider; OEM / manufacturer; asset operator; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: Worldwide satellite coverage and North American air-to-ground service

specialization.value: related lines: Aircraft broadband, onboard communications hardware, cabin networking and flight operations software

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Connectivity plans and managed services sold to aircraft owners, fleet operators and government customers; distributors / dealers: Authorized avionics dealers and aircraft maintenance and modification centers; partners / resellers: Aircraft manufacturers offering factory-installed connectivity systems
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FCC spectrum and communications licensing, plus FAA and other aviation authorities’ approvals for onboard equipment and installations
